title.description: Episode title as shown on YouTube. Hard limit 70 characters.

description.description: YouTube description. MUST contain (1) a 'Sources' section listing every cited source with its URL — include a line starting with 'Sources' — and (2) a synthetic-content / AI disclosure sentence containing the marker phrase 'Reconstructed composite' or equivalent disclosure language mentioning that visuals are reconstructed, not authentic footage. These markers are enforced by pipeline/validate/validate-metadata.ts via regex, not by schema pattern.

time_s.description: Chapter start time in seconds. Derive from the act start_s values in script.json.

label.description: Chapter label, e.g. the act name.

thumbnail_paths.description: Exactly two thumbnail PNG paths produced by Stage 6 (thumbnail-1.png and thumbnail-2.png).

disclosure.description: Synthetic-content flag. Must be true: the episode contains AI-generated voiceover and code-drawn reconstructed visuals, so the YouTube altered/synthetic content disclosure is required.
